title: Robust Bi-Tempered Logistic Loss Based on Bregman Divergences.
summary: Hardening the bi-tempered logistic loss - a generalized cross-entropy with bounded per-sample loss and a heavy-tail softmax - into Meridian's default training loss for noisy-label customer datasets. Recovers standard cross entropy at t1 = t2 = 1.0 and generalizes prior robust losses.
